preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of businesses is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The value of each business is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases will not exceed 5 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the number of businesses over all test cases is at most 5 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: The given roads connect every business
preconditions.description: There is a path between any two businesses in the graph formed by the roads.

postconditions.expression: Output T lines, each containing the maximum possible damage for the corresponding test case
postconditions.description: For each test case, output the maximum possible damage that can be achieved by destroying exactly one business.
